description: FDD 2.0: the design this prototype is built from, in a tab of its own. The page-head band (Open full screen, Download the PDF), a chip per chapter, and the document (resources/fdd2, written by docs/fdd-v2/tools/build-fdd-v2.js) in an iframe filling the rest of the tab. v = store.view('me') plus the document's links and chapters (resources/js/future/fxFdd2.js), set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh; src and chapter change only when a chip is clicked (chapterChain), so the store's changes never move the document.

v.description: store.view('me') plus fxFdd2.doc($application.path): the chapters (n, id, label, title), the document's address (html) and its PDF's (pdf).

src.description: The iframe's address: the document, plus #c<n> once a chapter's chip is clicked (fxFdd2.src). Set once by loadChain, then only by chapterChain.

chapter.description: The chapter whose chip was clicked last (1..15), its chip marked; 0: the document's cover.

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
